## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Relevant authorization, role-award, or restart behavior is covered.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` match any configuration changes.
- [ ] No tokens, private logs, or credentials are included.

For Discord-facing changes, describe the manual check in a test server.
